name: Chunk event log and decouple monolithic canonical-state into per-entity derived files
goal: Resolve the monolithic-state problem at both layers. (1) EVENT LOG: implement the already-designed PartitionedEvent chunking (src/infra/event-store.ts append(partition,event)/readPartition/readSegment) into .synth/data/event-stream/<partition>/<segment>.jsonl with an offset-ordered manifest, preserving deterministic replay. (2) PROJECTION: change StateStore.save (src/infra/state-store.ts:66) to write per-entity derived files (.synth/data/expeditions/<id>.json, .synth/data/missions/<id>.json) instead of one canonical-state.json; canonical-state.json becomes a generated aggregate (amend contract tracking rule). (3) dependsOn: make it a settable canonical attribute via expedition refine --depends-on (writes event, materialized into per-entity file). (4) Archive: relocate per-entity file to .synth/data/expeditions/archived/<id>.json (status marker), not a monolith shuffle. Single source of truth (event log) preserved; merge/review/scale improved.

metadata.cancelReason: Superseded by completed expedition 886dc15e19a8e587, whose goal explicitly lands this feature ('Land the partitioned event-store + per-entity derived-state feature from expedition 01604a3df9d2785d'). Artifacts verified present at HEAD: .synth/data/event-stream/partition-0..3, 60 per-entity expedition files, 5 mission files. Retiring the duplicate draft so it cannot be approved as fresh work.
